_note: Chelo's first-time tour and the opening story. Building steps pan the city and show buildings.json's about/do. 'story' lines type out one by one on the opening's cinematic screen; {name}, {class}, {coin}, {passage} are filled in.

steps.title: Welcome to Atlantis
steps.chelo: Quick tour before the tide turns.
lines: Goal: buy Passage on the last ship, owing nothing.
4 seasons, 6 tides each. A tide is one move.

steps.title: Your tides
steps.chelo: They run out faster than you think.
lines: Work, Market trips and Exchange visits cost tides. Everything else is free.

steps.chelo: Your household eats every season. Plan for it.
Free to visit, as often as you like.
Your way out. Also where coin grows, or sinks.
Fun. Just remember who wins in the end.
Grin always says yes. That's the problem.
When the Council speaks, prices move.

steps.title: The price of Passage
lines: Your goal, and how close you are. Idle coin falls behind it.

steps.title: Off you go
steps.chelo: I'll see you at the end of each season.
lines: Click a building to go in. Drag to look around.
Every room has a Modern Mirror: what it is in the real world.

story.text: For three hundred years, the tides of Atlantis never lied.
This spring, the Council read them one last time.
When the Long Dark ends, Atlantis sinks.
One ship will leave. Passage costs {passage}◈, and the price rises every season.
It carries no one who owes a single coin.
You are {name}, {class}, with {coin}◈ to your name.
Four seasons. Six tides each. Make them count.
